## 5. Study Concepts Generated

### Study Concept — Caplyta (lumateperone)
**Evidence gap:** PANSS Positive Subscale · Schizophrenia, Acute (≤8 wk) (white space)

## Recommended design
**Phase 4 / IIS randomized placebo-controlled** — Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled 5-week study with PANSS Positive Subscale as primary endpoint
- Rationale: Efficacy / function white space or low-validity cell; a controlled design with this scale as primary endpoint is needed to move validity to L4.
- Arms: Study drug, Placebo, Active reference arm (optional)
- Blinding: Double-blind
- Duration: 5 weeks
- Primary endpoint: PANSS Positive Subscale — change from baseline to week 5
- Primary analysis: MMRM change from baseline (multiplicity-controlled key secondaries)

## Secondary endpoints (frequency in precedent trials)
- Response Rate (45 precedent trials)
- PANSS Total (34 precedent trials)
- PANSS Negative Subscale (31 precedent trials)
- PANSS Marder Negative Factor (26 precedent trials)
- CGI-Severity (24 precedent trials)
- Negative Symptoms (NSA-16 / BNSS / SANS) (12 precedent trials)

## Sample size (80% power, two-sided α = 0.05)
- Method: two-sample comparison of means (MMRM-equivalent)
- Assumption: d = 0.46 (80% of historical median |d| 0.58, k=6 endpoints in Schizophrenia)
- N per arm: 74 → 97 after 23% dropout; total ≈ 194

- Age: 18–65 years (modal range in precedents)
- Typical PANSS entry threshold ≥ 70 (12 precedents)
- Typical CGI-S entry threshold ≥ 4 (10 precedents)

## Methods

**Evidence tiers:** Tier 1A — FDA USPI label claim, registry result matched to a USPI §14 row, or head-to-head Phase 3/4 superiority; Tier 1B — Industry-sponsored registrational Phase 3/4 RCT — primary or multiplicity-controlled key secondary endpoint; Tier 2 — Industry Phase 2 RCT, Phase 3 nominal (non-controlled) secondary, post-hoc / pooled analysis, or (network) meta-analysis; Tier 3 — Academic / investigator-initiated study, observational cohort, case series, or exploratory endpoint

**Validity levels:** L5 — USPI §14 label claim, or Phase 3 primary endpoint positive (p<0.05) in ≥2 trials; L4 — Single Phase 3 primary endpoint, Phase 3 multiplicity-controlled key secondary, or large (N≥300) Phase 4 RCT; L3 — Phase 3 nominal secondary / post-hoc, meta-analysis, or RWE cohort with N>500; L2 — Phase 2 RCT, or academic trial with N 50–500; L1 — Small IIS (N<50), case series, exploratory biomarker, or unclassifiable

Every quantitative claim is drawn from a registry field, USPI section or citation-validated verbatim quote stored in mednik.
